BNL's own central-campus-map key confirms 'Booster (AGS)' as Building 942, map coordinate G3, which corroborates the identification, but the OpenStreetMap shape is only a hand-labelled locality boundary around the AGS Booster synchrotron's approximate footprint, not a surveyed or technically aligned trace of its ring. The Atlas has no Booster accelerator record yet, so this is drawn as a context feature not linked to any accelerator, for orientation only, and is not a claim about the Booster's true ring geometry.
